related.title: mixup：輸入與軟標籤同步混合
related.titleEn: mixup: synchronized input and soft-label mixing
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付機率質量表、端點測試與評估指標對照。；.925與.85正確，四類機率和1且平滑只套一次。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver probability tables,endpoint tests and metric comparisons.; Values match,probability sums1 and smoothing is applied once.
related.difference: 列輸入、one-hot標籤、配對索引與λ四欄，產生軟標籤[.25,.75]。；8與4正確，交換不變性成立，target和1且無整數截斷。
related.differenceEn: List inputs,one-hot labels,pair indices and lambda to form soft label[.25,.75].; Results match,swap invariance holds and targets sum1 without truncation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 採均勻混合目標q=(1−ε)onehot+ε/K，真類別qtrue=1−ε+ε/K。；教學K4,ε.1；改ε.2，這不同於只向錯誤類別分配ε的慣例。；qtrue=1−.1+.1/4=.925；改後.85。
xmix=λxa+(1−λ)xb，標籤必用同一λ與同一配對。；教學標量xa2,xb10,λ.25；改λ.75。；xmix=.25×2+.75×10=8；改後4。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Uniform-mixed targets are q=(1−epsilon)onehot+epsilon/K, giving qtrue=1−epsilon+epsilon/K.; Teaching K4,epsilon.1 then.2; this differs from distributing epsilon only over incorrect classes.; qtrue=1−.1+.1/4=.925; changed result.85.
xmix=lambda xa+(1−lambda)xb; labels must use the same lambda and pairing.; Teaching scalar inputs2 and10,lambda.25 then.75.; xmix=.25×2+.75×10=8; changed result4.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: TPU 主機供料：infeed 與 MXU 的串接預算
related.titleEn: TPU host infeed: feeding the MXU
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付機率質量表、端點測試與評估指標對照。；.925與.85正確，四類機率和1且平滑只套一次。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver probability tables,endpoint tests and metric comparisons.; Values match,probability sums1 and smoothing is applied once.
related.difference: 建立每批主機處理、傳送與計算時間，分開串行延遲與穩態吞吐。
related.differenceEn: Budget preprocessing, transfer and compute per batch, separating serial latency from steady-state throughput.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 採均勻混合目標q=(1−ε)onehot+ε/K，真類別qtrue=1−ε+ε/K。；教學K4,ε.1；改ε.2，這不同於只向錯誤類別分配ε的慣例。；qtrue=1−.1+.1/4=.925；改後.85。
三段完全串行時 T=a+b+c；三段獨立可重疊時穩態批間隔至少 max(a,b,c)，首批仍需全部三段。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 合成每批主機處理12 ms、傳送4 ms、MXU計算8 ms；無競爭且緩衝足夠。 串行24 ms/批；重疊後12 ms/批，吞吐約83.333批/s。最初24 ms延遲沒有消失。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Uniform-mixed targets are q=(1−epsilon)onehot+epsilon/K, giving qtrue=1−epsilon+epsilon/K.; Teaching K4,epsilon.1 then.2; this differs from distributing epsilon only over incorrect classes.; qtrue=1−.1+.1/4=.925; changed result.85.

Serial latency is a+b+c; independent overlapped stages have interval at least max(a, b, c), while first-batch latency still spans all stages. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Synthetic per-batch stages:12 ms host processing, 4 ms transfer, 8 ms compute, with independent resources and sufficient buffers. Serial execution takes24 ms/batch; overlap gives12 ms intervals, 83.333 batches/s; initial24 ms latency remains.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
